[[The Peacekeeper]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[axe]] dropped by the [[Peacekeeper Enforcer]]s and [[Peacekeeper Goon]]s in [[Kryta]] during the [[War in Kryta]]

==Stats==
:[[Slashing damage]]: 6-28 (Requires 9 [[Axe Mastery]])
:[[Damage]] +15% (while health is above 50%)
:[[Armor penetration]] +20% (Chance: 20%)
:[[Health]] +30

==Skin==
This item uses the same skin as a [[Greater Summit Axe]].
